text.japanese: それは新しいです。そして美味しいです。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: ああ、赤いですね。あれは青いですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: いいえ、あれは青ではありません。赤です。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: どれを食べますか。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: この小さいのを食べます。あなたもどうぞ。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: ありがとうございます。私は大きいのを食べたいです。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: どうぞ。飲みますか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: いいえ、もう飲みました。失礼します。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: さようなら。

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Good evening. Is this new, or is it old?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: That is new. And it is delicious.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Oh, it is red, isn't it? Is that one over there blue?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: No, that one over there is not blue. It is red.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Which one will you eat?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: I will eat this small one. Please, you too.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Thank you very much. I want to eat the big one.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Please do. Will you drink?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: No, I already drank. Excuse me.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Goodbye.

listeningQuestions: What does Speaker 2 say about the first item Speaker 1 asks about?
What color does Speaker 1 think the item is?
Is the item over there blue?
Which item does Speaker 2 choose to eat?
Does Speaker 1 want to drink at the end?
answerKey: He says it is new and delicious.
No, it is not blue; it is red.
No, she says she already drank.
